jobTitles.title: Job titles / keywords
jobTitles.description: One search per title. Boolean operators work (e.g. "python AND django").

titleMatch.title: Job title must match
titleMatch.description: LinkedIn's search is fuzzy ("AI Engineer" also returns "Electrical Engineer"). Exact phrase (default): the job title must contain your whole keyword, words in order ("Senior AI Engineer" yes, "AI Software Engineer" no). All words: every word of your keyword must be in the title, any order. Off: keep everything LinkedIn returns. Spelling variants count as the same (Full-Stack = Fullstack, A.I. = AI = Artificial Intelligence). Non-matching jobs are skipped and never charged.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Every title is searched in every location. Use "Worldwide" for no location filter.

searchUrls.title: LinkedIn search URLs (optional)
searchUrls.description: Paste linkedin.com/jobs/search URLs directly. Their own filters are kept. Runs in addition to titles × locations.

maxResultsPerSearch.title: Max jobs per search
maxResultsPerSearch.description: Limit per title × location combination. LinkedIn exposes up to ~1,000 per search.

maxResultsTotal.title: Max jobs in total
maxResultsTotal.description: Hard cap for the whole run (0 = no cap). Controls your cost.

postedWithin.title: Date posted
postedWithin.description: Only return jobs posted within this time window.

workTypes.title: Work type
workTypes.description: On-site, remote and/or hybrid. LinkedIn does not apply this filter for logged-out visitors, so every job is checked against its own title and description, and only jobs that clearly state a matching arrangement are saved (and charged).

includeUnclearJobs.title: Include jobs that don't state it (blank work type)
includeUnclearJobs.description: Off (default, recommended): with a work type filter, only jobs whose post clearly states remote / hybrid / on-site are saved, so the Work Type column is never blank. With experience or job type filters, only jobs that state them are saved. On: also save jobs where the detail is not stated (Work Type left blank).

jobTypes.title: Job type
jobTypes.description: Full-time, contract, internship, etc. Verified against the employment type shown on each job page; non-matching jobs are skipped and not charged.

experienceLevels.title: Experience level
experienceLevels.description: Seniority levels to include. Verified against the seniority shown on each job page; non-matching jobs are skipped and not charged.

easyApplyOnly.title: Easy Apply only
easyApplyOnly.description: Only return jobs that use LinkedIn Easy Apply.

under10Applicants.title: Fewer than 10 applicants
under10Applicants.description: Only jobs with fewer than 10 applicants (early-bird jobs).

companyIds.title: Company IDs (optional)
companyIds.description: Restrict to LinkedIn numeric company IDs (e.g. 1441 for Google).

distanceMiles.title: Distance from location (miles)
distanceMiles.description: Radius around each location. Leave empty for LinkedIn default.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Most recent first, or LinkedIn relevance order.

scrapeJobDetails.title: Scrape full job details
scrapeJobDetails.description: Full description, salary, seniority, industries, applicants, apply type, recruiter. Turn off for a fast, cheaper listing-only run. Always on when work type, experience level or job type filters are used.

excludeCompanies.title: Exclude companies
excludeCompanies.description: Case-insensitive company names to skip (e.g. recruiting agencies).

skipPreviouslyScraped.title: Skip jobs from previous runs
skipPreviouslyScraped.description: For scheduled daily runs: jobs already delivered by an earlier run (with the same history name) are skipped and not charged, so every run gives only new jobs. Lets you search a wider window such as "Past week" every day without repeats. History is kept for 90 days.

historyName.title: History name
historyName.description: Name of the key-value store in your account that remembers delivered jobs. Use a different name for each separate search you schedule.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel requests. Higher is faster; with residential proxies 25 is a good default.

maxRequestsPerMinute.title: Max requests per minute
maxRequestsPerMinute.description: Throttle for LinkedIn requests. Leave empty for automatic: 400/min with a proxy, 60/min without.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies give the most reliable results on LinkedIn.
